_about: Hand-authored equipment, merged into the generated pack by tools/extract/build_documents.py (apply_manual_content). Put entries under "entries", keyed by name, with the item's system fields. A new name is added, tagged sourcebook "Custom" unless you give one. A name his data already builds is ignored unless the entry says "_override": true, in which case only the fields you give are laid over his. Keys starting with _ are notes and never read. Full guide: docs/ADDING-CONTENT.md. Rebuild with: python tools/extract/build_documents.py --write

_example._note: An example of the shape. Copy entries from here into "entries" to use them.

entries._weights: Weights are anchored to his own equipvalueslist rather than to anything outside it, so a character's encumbrance reads consistently: Pick(Digging) 5, Shovel 6, Tongs(Large) 5, Grappling Hook 3.

Crowbar.description: A three-foot iron bar, flattened and split at one end for prying and drawn to a point at the other. Worth a bonus to forcing a door, a lid or a grate at the Game Master's discretion, and it can be swung in a pinch, though it is not a weapon. Not in the Roll20 sheet; added at the owner's request 2026-09-19.
